'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**[[Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict]]
***The [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] launch a [[missile]] strike on the [[Saudi Arabia]]n city of [[Jizan]], killing two people and injuring seven more. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/saudi-led-coalition-says-hostile-projectile-hits-jazan-state-media-2021-12-24/ (Reuters)]
***Three people are killed and six others are injured during [[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen|coalition]] air raids in Ajama, [[Yemen]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/25/several-killed-as-saudi-arabia-and-yemen-rebels-exchange-fire (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Russo-Ukrainian crisis]]
**[[government of Russia|Russian]] [[President of Russia|president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] demands that [[NATO]] guarantee that it will not move its forces into [[Ukraine]], accusing NATO and the [[United States|U.S.]] of "trying to send Ukraine and [[Russia]] into direct [[armed conflict]]." [https://www.independent.ie/world-news/europe/we-dont-want-conflict-but-we-need-assurance-putin-tells-nato-41179711.html (''The Irish Independent'')]
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**After five days of [[military training]], [[Iran]] fires sixteen [[ballistic missiles]] at a target in a [[show of force]] against [[Israel]]. The incident is part of a wider increase in tensions between the two countries. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/middle-east/20211224-iran-fires-missiles-during-drills-in-warning-to-israel (RFI)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]; [[2021 Niger attacks]]
**[[Jihadism|Jihadists]] kill six [[Niger Armed Forces|soldiers]] in [[Niger]], resulting in the ensuing deaths of twenty-two of the attackers. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/dec/25/central-africa-fighting-kills-six-soldiers-and-22-jihadists-in-lake-chad-region (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
**The [[United Nations]] [[Economic Commission for Africa]] warns that the effects of the [[pandemic]] on [[Economy of Africa|Africa's economy]] could push the number of "extremely poor" Africans to 514 million people. The [[World Bank]] also announced a [[recession]] as the economies of African countries continue to shrink. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-business-health-poverty-africa-a27692e54c861280b22abe5725d5489f (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Bangladesh ferry fire]]
**At least 39 people are killed and 100 others are injured after a [[ferry]] catches fire in [[Jhalakathi]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-59777784 (BBC News)]
*Sixteen people are dead as a boat carrying migrants overturn and sink near the island of [[Paros]], [[Greece]]. Sixty-three more people are rescued. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/25/16-migrants-dead-in-greek (Al Jazeera)]
*A [[Surfing|surfer]] is killed an apparent [[shark attack]] in [[Morro Bay, California|Morro Bay]], off the coast of [[California]], [[United States]]. It is the first fatal shark attack in the area since 2003. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-59792120 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in France]]
*****The [[France|French]] {{Interlanguage link|Haute Autorité de santé|fr}} recommends that [[booster dose|booster doses]] of the COVID-19 vaccine can be administered as soon as three months after the primary vaccination schedule due to the spread of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/french-health-authority-recommends-booster-dose-after-just-three-months/ (''Politico.eu'')]
****France reports a record for the second consecutive day of 94,122 new cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/france-sets-new-daily-covid-infections-record-01640373307 (''Barron's'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] cancels all public [[Christmas]] and [[New Year's Eve]] celebrations, as well as mandates [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask wearing]] outdoors and requiring people to wear two masks or a high-protection mask in order to use [[public transport]] and enter supermarkets due to the spread of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/greece-christmas-new-year-celebations-omicron-b1981373.html (''The Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 50,599 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 5.57 million. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/italy-reports-record-50599-coronavirus-cases-friday-141-deaths-2021-12-24/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Catalonia]] reimposes a curfew between 1 a.m. and 6 a.m. in [[Municipalities of Catalonia|municipalities]] where the infection rate surpasses 250 cases per 100,000 inhabitants, limits the number of people in social gatherings to 10, closes nightclubs, and restricts the capacity of the hospitality sector due to the spread of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant. These measures will be in effect until at least January 7. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-12-spain-catalonia-reimpose-curfew-covid.html (MedicalXpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 122,186 new cases of COVID-19. [https://www.itv.com/news/2021-12-24/uk-records-largest-ever-daily-rise-in-covid-cases-with-122186-reported (ITV News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bhutan]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Bhutan]]
****[[Bhutan]] begins administering [[booster dose|booster doses]] of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] for people over the age of 65 years, overseas travellers, [[healthcare workers]], people with underlying health conditions, and adults living in high risk areas. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-12-24/bhutan-starts-giving-covid-19-booster-shots (U.S. News and World Report)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] reports no deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours for the first time since September 19. [https://www.rappler.com/world/asia-pacific/thailand-reports-first-omicron-cluster-december-24-2021/ (Rappler)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports its first domestic cluster of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in 21 people from [[Kalasin province]]. The outbreak originated in a couple who travelled from [[Belgium]] earlier this month. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/thailand-reports-first-omicron-covid-19-cluster-cancels-some-new-year-events-2400031 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Ecumenical Patriarch]] of the [[Eastern Orthodox Church]] [[Bartholomew I of Constantinople]] tests positive for COVID-19 and is showing mild symptoms. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/ecumenical-patriarch-bartholomew-tests-positive-covid-19-81932025 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
***The [[South Africa|South African]] [[Department of Health (South Africa)|Health Department]] suspends COVID-19 contact tracing and quarantine for people with asymptomatic cases due to 80% of the population being vaccinated or recovered from COVID-19. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-12-24/south-africa-to-stop-quarantines-as-80-have-past-infection (Bloomberg)]
